messages:
ira.k: Quick alert - found 11 invoices from the 2026-09-15 midday emit missing compute.gpu lines. Example inv_04199z (skyline). PDF already sent but totals look understated. :grimacing:
marta.d: Which emitter? standard or fast-path?
ira.k: emitter: `mid-emit-2026-09-15-12z`. Logs show emit before usage-merge finished. Snippet:
```
[12:00:04] emitInvoice(inv_04199z) -> EMITTED total=1,200.00 items=2
[12:00:05] usage-merge(inv_04199z) -> COMPLETED added_rows=3
```
billing-bot: Automated alerts: missing_sku_compute.gpu (11 ids), duplicate_pdf_puts (2 ids). Report uploaded -> s3://billing/alerts/3090012345/alert.json
ops: Likely race: emit doesn't wait for merge finish. Short term: pause outbound email for `mid-emit-2026-09-15-12z`. Long term: add a 90s guard or a promise-based wait.
support: For the 2 customers with duplicate PDFs, prepare templates and flag if they've already replied.
ira.k: Proposed remediation: 1) run dry reconcile: `billingctl reconcile --batch mid-emit-2026-09-15-12z --dry --out /tmp/recon-3090012345.csv`; 2) if delta <= $7,500 auto-backfill+re-emit with `--no-email`; 3) > $7,500 route to finance. Approve?
finance: Approve auto re-emit for deltas <= $7,500. Anything above needs manual sign-off.
marta.d: Kicked off dry-run at 3090012360. Preliminary: 11 affected, deltas range -$32 to +$5,400. No invoices exceed $7,500.
ops: I'll disable email send for that batch (done). I'll also open a PR to add idempotent S3 upload keys to pdf-worker to avoid duplicates.
ira.k: Ok to proceed with auto backfill and re-emit `--no-email` for QA. We'll send customer emails after manual spot-check. Posting dry-run CSV: s3://billing/recons/dry-3090012345.csv
support: Templates ready in /docs/support/reissue-mid-2026-09-15.md. I'll stand by for the final send list.
ira.k: Backfill started and re-emit with no-email completed. Logs show updated totals and expected compute.gpu rows attached. Will post final re-emit log shortly. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
